name: Dexter
description: Researches financial questions autonomously in the terminal: plans steps, pulls income statements, balance sheets and cash flows, and checks its own answers.

skills.name: Research Planning
skills.description: Breaks a complex financial question into structured research steps before gathering any data.

skills.name: Financial Statements
skills.description: Pulls income statements, balance sheets and cash flow statements from live market data to answer the question.

skills.name: Self-Validation
skills.description: Checks its own work and iterates until the answer is complete, with loop detection and step limits to stop runaway runs.

skills.name: Use from WhatsApp
skills.description: Answers financial research questions sent over WhatsApp, as described in the project's WhatsApp setup guide.
